scene: You roll into breezy Sky Dock as your airship docks.
picture: Pixel art side view on a wooden platform. On the left sits the moored patched airship. A yellow cargo crane stands far left. Left of centre, a South Asian girl with a black braid in a teal hoodie sits in a purple wheelchair. A ticket vendor waits at centre, and a brass elevator waits far right.
shown: a yellow mechanical cargo crane humming on the far left
a friendly ticket vendor leaning on a wooden booth at centre
a brass elevator door with a glowing red button on the far right
